title: One item and every record it holds
description: What GET /api/v1/items/{key} answers and `ingestion items show --json` prints: the item, each home its file lives at, each sighting, each stage's output, each gate decision, each delivery, its latest suggestion, and the quality gate's and the model read's current answers.

source_ts.description: When the artifact was made at its source, such as a Reddit post's creation, and null where its source gives no time.

md5.description: The bytes' MD5, which a reader such as sioyek keys a book's annotations by.

homes.description: Each place the item's file lives under a named root, where it was referenced rather than copied. A home gone from its root keeps its row.

path.description: The file's place below its root, with forward slashes.

modified_ts.description: The file's modification time, to the nanosecond, when its bytes were last hashed at this path.

fields.description: Values the connector read from the source's payload, by name, such as a Reddit save's subreddit. A routing rule matches them. Outsider text where the zone is outside.

metrics.description: The source's counts by name, such as a video's duration_s, views, likes and comments. Each name holds the newest value that carried it, from the connector's arrivals or from the daily refresh of an item waiting in review. A refresh leaves out a views, likes or comments count that reads 0, which the source also answers where it hides one.

cursor_position.description: The connector's cursor where it last delivered the item.

last_seen_ts.description: The last arrival that changed the sighting.

metrics_read_ts.description: When the metrics were last taken from the source, by an arrival that changed them or by a refresh that read them, changed or not. Null where no read stamped them.

note_digest.description: The hex SHA-256 of the note a model read answered, and null where it answered none.

span.description: The matched text, at most its first 1024 bytes, and null where the scan holds no span for it.

rules_version.description: The scanner rules' version that made the findings: a scan's over its parse, and a model read's over its suggestion sentence.

answer.description: A model stage's structured answer, and the structure stage's profile of a PDF. A model read's holds its summary and its suggestion sentence.

dispatch_id.description: A model stage's dispatch, where the model port started one.

model.description: The model that a model stage asked its run for.

effort.description: The effort that a model stage asked its run for.

answered_model.description: The model that a model stage's run reports answering on.

lens.description: How a model read takes the item, on a read decision whose verdict is model, and on a shelf whose opening reads it by a model.

playlist.description: The playlist that a sort by watch adds the video to, on its side decision, and null on every other decision.

client_id.description: The client that sent a person's decision.

decided_after_ms.description: How long after its review card was drawn the person decided, in milliseconds.

destination_id.description: The id of the destination's record that holds the item, or that a refusal names.

outcome.description: delivered-to-existing is a record that the destination held before the write, as its answer to that write said: one under no key that took the item's key, or, for learning-resources, one that the key already named. A retry whose first answer was lost reads delivered under life-articles, and delivered-to-existing under learning-resources. refused is a destination's answer naming an existing record that conflicts with the item, kept with that record's id and never retried. pending waits on its task, which tries again after a failure, or was withdrawn, as last_error then says.

last_error.description: The destination's answer to the last write that failed, what a refusal names, or why the delivery was withdrawn.

playlist.description: The playlist that a watch's delivery adds the video to, as its sort picked it, and null for every other deliverer.

unclaimed_capability.description: The capability of the delivery's queued task where no worker heard from lately holds it, so nothing here writes to that destination yet, and null otherwise.

sections.description: The item's sections, each producer version's rows in order, as schemas/ingestion-record.schema.json's sections describe them. A title is outsider text where the zone is outside. Absent from a service that keeps none.

child_key.description: The chapter's own item, which takes this item's side and read decisions.

undelivered.description: Why an item placed on a side and read as is reaches no deliverer, and null where it does.

reason.description: Why the item reaches no deliverer, as one of an open set: a later release may add a reason, so a reader shows one it does not know by its message. no-side-default: the placement named a side and no destination, and no destination in the set in force is that side's default, so the item waits for a set that names one. not-declared: the set in force does not declare the destination placed on. no-deliverer: the destination names no deliverer, as one whose reader pulls its items itself. not-taken: the destination's deliverer cannot write the item, as one that saves links cannot write an item with no URL, one that writes by file cannot write a book with no live home below its root, and one that writes no chapters cannot write a book's chapter. book-unsettled: the item is a book's chapter, and its book's delivery to the destination has not settled on a record, so the chapter waits for the record it is part of. book-refused: the item is a book's chapter, and the destination refused its book, so no record there holds the chapter.

progress.description: The parse's and the scan's progress, read from each stage's tasks as well as its outputs. A stage that nothing queued is left out.

state.description: running: a task of the stage is queued or leased, whatever its last output was. done: an output of the stage is done. failed: no task of it is left to run and none of its outputs is done.

error.description: Why the stage failed, from its newest task where that failed and from a failed output otherwise, and null where neither says.

waiting.description: Why the item waits at a model stage, and null where it waits at none.

reason.description: first-fill: a connector's first fill holds the task until it is released. dispatched: the model port started a run that has not answered, and message carries why in the dispatch service's words, such as a budget that holds it. unclaimed: no worker heard from lately claims the task's capability, as where no worker's config names a [model] adapter. queued: a worker claims the task next.

held_by.description: The connector whose first fill holds the task.

last_error.description: Why the task's last try did not go through, such as a dispatch service that did not answer or a usage limit that waits for its reset, and null where the last try went through. The task tries again after its backoff.

quality_answer.description: The quality gate's newest done answer, which GET /api/v1/review serves under the same name, in the shape prompts/quality/answer.schema.json holds. Null where the gate gave none. Its idea and themes are a model's reading of the item, so they take the item's zone.

model_read.description: The item's newest done model read, with the scanner's findings over its suggestion sentence, and null where no model read is done. Its summary and sentence are a model's reading of the item, so they take the item's zone.
